# SignatureDecoder

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/04c494d92ce87df3b9ba252c17541e08e28fdf97/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/common/SignatureDecoder.sol)

**Title:** SignatureDecoder - Decodes signatures encoded as bytes

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Functions

<a id="signaturesplit-bytes-uint256"></a>

### signatureSplit

Splits signature bytes into `uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s`.

<i>

Make sure to perform a bounds check for @param pos, to avoid out of bounds access on @param signatures
     The signature format is a compact form of `bytes32 r``bytes32 s``uint8 v`
     Compact means uint8 is not padded to 32 bytes.

</i>

```solidity
function signatureSplit(bytes memory signatures, uint256 pos) internal pure returns (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| signatures | `bytes` | Concatenated `r, s, v` signatures. |
| pos | `uint256` | Which signature to read.<br/>           A prior bounds check of this parameter should be performed, to avoid out of bounds access. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| v | `uint8` | Recovery ID or Safe signature type. |
| r | `bytes32` | Output value r of the signature. |
| s | `bytes32` | Output value s of the signature. |
